21631d.conditions: nlevels=2 in ExchangePrunedRows: a fast neighbour finishes level 1 and Isends its level-2 ROW_PRUNED_REQ_TAG request before a slower rank has drained its level-1 requests; there is no barrier between levels before SendRequests
21631d.reasoning: ExchangePrunedRows uses the same tag (221) for requests at every level. Each level does SendRequests (Isend), then Allreduce, then num_replies x ReceiveRequest (Probe ANY_SOURCE), then the replies. Rank 0 can get rank 1's level-1 reply, finish level 1 and send its level-2 request to rank 1 while rank 1 is still in its level-1 receive loop and rank 2's level-1 request is still unmatched. Rank 1's wildcard probe at line 153 may take rank 0's level-2 request instead. Rank 1 then answers rank 0 and never answers rank 2 in level 1. It goes on to the level-2 Allreduce. Rank 2 waits forever in ReceiveReplyPrunedRows (ParaSails.c:250) for rank 1's level-1 reply. The Allreduce never completes, so the program deadlocks. MPI permits this matching: the two messages come from different senders, and Open MPI's wildcard matching is not ordered by time.
